title: travel salt and peppers
text: travel salt and peppers. These are plastic... I was hoping that the tops would be a bit more flexible or silicone... but they are hard plastic - making them difficult to remove.  They have flip tops that seem to stay closed.  The bottoms are sort of clearish - you will be able to see which is pepper and which is salt or whatever your season choice is.  The top holes are all the same size.  I did hand wash these - but I do have a top, top dishwasher tray for little things and I think these might be ok there.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
